probes.name: Probe LLM-Stage1 -- LLM Stage1 Isolation
probes.stage1_source: cached zero-shot LLM predictions (h11/llm/stage1_llm_predictions.parquet, gpt-4o-mini, prompt_version=stage1_v1, unchanged)
probes.hypothesis: With Stage2 held at a constant trivial baseline, any leaderboard score above the trivial floor is attributable to the zero-shot LLM's real Stage1 predictive contribution (M1_real_LLM).
probes.expected_leaderboard_interpretation: Leaderboard score reflects M1_real_LLM's weighted contribution (0.3 of total) plus Stage2's trivial M2 contribution (0.7 * M2_trivial, expected clipped to 0 since 'always Applicable' clips macro-F2 per CLAUDE.md); isolates the LLM's real Stage1 skill for comparison against C1's Probe B reading (H11 Part 1).

probes.name: Probe LLM-Stage2 -- LLM Stage2 Isolation
probes.stage2_source: cached structured-field LLM predictions (h11/llm/stage2_llm_predictions.parquet, gpt-4o-mini, prompt_version=stage2_v1, unchanged)
probes.hypothesis: With Stage1 held at a constant trivial baseline, any leaderboard score above the trivial floor is attributable to the LLM's real Stage2 predictive contribution (M2_real_LLM).
probes.expected_leaderboard_interpretation: Leaderboard score reflects M2_real_LLM's weighted contribution (0.7 of total) plus Stage1's trivial M1 contribution (0.3 * M1_trivial, expected near the M1 floor); isolates the LLM's real Stage2 skill for comparison against G's Probe A reading (H11 Part 1).
